items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Alfred Laine Interview, 1951-04-21
items.q: I was in New York playing with Jimmy Durante.

ctx.x: This is Alfred John Lane. I'm talking about 531 Cluett Street for my daddy right now, and he and I was just now talking, and we were talking about things gone by years ago. Of course, I'm 56 years old today. I'm not a young man, and I was with Jimmy Durante when I was 19 years old. I was in New York playing with Jimmy Durante. I don't think I have much more to say to you, but nevertheless...
Well, didn't you have your own band while your daddy's was called?
